acceptanceCriteria: A deterministic test shows the Gemini hook reporting cleanup unconfirmed for a zombie group on the base and confirmed after the fix, or a retained run shows the hook is not affected.
Any contract change is recorded as an owner-accepted AHI amendment.
body: Found in lane H (V1-1116, PR beamfall/corvint#745). Proven locally on Darwin: a process group whose members are unreaped zombies answers kill(-pid, 0) with EPERM, and libuv runs timers before the poll phase that reaps the leader, so a single probe after a stalled termination turn sees EPERM and reports cleanup unconfirmed. #745 fixes the OpenCode adapter (bounded EPERM re-probe, proposed AHI-052). integrations/gemini-cli/hooks/corvint-hook.mjs (cleanup check near line 354-364 at main 3beedd98) still makes one `process.kill(-child.pid, 0)` probe and returns error?.code === "ESRCH" only. Suspected, not reproduced on hosted CI for Gemini. Any fix changes the AHI-050 contract for Gemini and needs owner acceptance like AHI-052.
title: Gemini CLI hook cleanup confirmation uses a single signal-0 probe that a zombie process group answers EPERM
